The author justification covers only AUDIT_DIR/instance-lock, and that half is TRUE (engine.py:107 _NETWORK_AUDIT_DIR is per-FOLLOWER_NETWORK, 111 honours HL_LIVE_AUDIT_DIR, 7933/7987 acquire_instance_lock(AUDIT_DIR)). rows.probe: Read the actual check detail, not the row name: NET_LIFE_SETTLE checks[NET-007:CERT_LEADER_MAINNET_FOLLOWER_TESTNET] -> detail 'cert: leader=mainnet, follower=testnet'; compared with the NET-003 pair which carry the same shape.
rows.why: UPHELD FAIL. The check asserts topology only and its detail is the same kind of statement as NET-003 two checks (leader=mainnet, follower=testnet). exchange_truth.resolve_networks() maps a network NAME to a host; it never reads a leader address, never verifies an active third-party leader, and no leader fill in the artifact is attributed to a real mainnet wallet. A synthetic mainnet-labelled leader passes this check identically, so it cannot test 'no synthetic or self-controlled leader'.

rows.why: DEMOTED from author PASS. The harness is genuinely non-vacuous - I mutated the engine and every check flipped to FAIL: M1 rename last_copy_poll_age_ms -> 'ASSERT: not found in SERVICE_STATE_FILE'; M2 flip the comparison -> 'Expected COPY_POLL_STALE, got ""'; M3 drop the increment -> 'network_errors should be > 0, got 0'; M4 force send_block_reason empty -> 'Expected MASTER_REAL_ORDERS_OFF'. Tooling sound. The PASS still fails the ROW: the row asks for the age of the last MASTER truth read and for staleness to BLOCK SIZING. The measured field is last_copy_poll_ms, set after poll_copy_account_fills() - the FOLLOWER copy-account poll (6423 cursor, 6457 stamp) - not a master-truth read; master truth is the snapshot refresh stamped in last_exchange_snapshot_refresh_ms (6459-6467), whose age is never surfaced. The gate it exercises (6348 -> _entry_sends_blocked_reason) blocks only ENTRY/ADD lifecycle sends at send_if_allowed 3251-3254; sizing is never consulted. Right test, wrong subject.

rows.probe: Asked whether the blocking reason the row names is reachable and published: grep -c FIXED_MODE_AUTHORITY_HOLD engine.py = 0; grep -c ACCOUNT_NET_TRUTH_UNAVAILABLE engine.py = 0; enumerated the state payload (5899-5935) and every use of _entry_sends_blocked_reason (6026, 6057, 6364, 6420).
rows.why: DEMOTED from author PASS. The harness checks that CycleSummary.send_block_reason reads MASTER_REAL_ORDERS_OFF when auto-send is off and empty when on - that pair is real and mutation-sensitive, but it reports the AUTO-SEND FLAG, not the blocking reason. The row own examples (FIXED_MODE_AUTHORITY_HOLD, ACCOUNT_NET_TRUTH_UNAVAILABLE) occur ZERO times in the engine. The real cycle-level block reason lives in self._entry_sends_blocked_reason (WS_FEED_STALE, COPY_POLL_STALE, UNRECONCILED_FILLED_SENDS, TOO_MANY_ACTIVE_WALLETS, DAILY_LOSS_*) and is NEVER written into the state payload - the payload is asdict(summary) plus fixed keys, and CycleSummary has no such field. An operator reading live_service_state.json cannot see why entries are blocked.
